name: Mason Cube Challenge 2024
information: If you are a first-time competitor, the [Registration Process and FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MasonCubeChallenge2024#37826-registration-process-and-faq-for-new-competitors) tab has useful information how the competition will look.
